# LivingCost.org

> > Comprehensive cost of living and quality of life comparison platform covering 9,294 cities across 197 countries worldwide.

LivingCost.org provides detailed cost of living calculators, city rankings, and liveability indexes to help individuals, expats, and researchers compare living expenses and quality of life across global destinations. The platform features extensive data on countries including India, Italy, Switzerland, Singapore, United States, United Kingdom, and many others.

## Cost of Living Calculator

- [World Cost of Living Calculator: 9294 cities, 197 countries](https://livingcost.org/cost): Global cost of living calculator covering 9294 cities across 197 countries

## India City Rankings

- [The 21 Best Places to live in Maharashtra ranked by Quality & Cost of living](https://livingcost.org/best/india/mh): Top 21 cities in Maharashtra, India by quality and cost (Mumbai, Pune)
- [The 12 Best Places to live in Gujarat ranked by Quality & Cost of living](https://livingcost.org/best/india/gj): Best cities in Gujarat, India ranked by liveability (Ahmedabad, Surat)

## Italy Regional Rankings

- [The 10 Best Places to live in Sicily ranked by Quality & Cost of living](https://livingcost.org/best/italy/si): Best cities in Sicily, Italy ranked by liveability (Catania, Palermo)
- [The 6 Best Places to live in Sardinia ranked by Quality & Cost of living](https://livingcost.org/best/italy/sa): Top 6 cities in Sardinia, Italy by quality and cost (Cagliari, Olbia)
